g.text: 100,000 synthetic input rows | Same workflow definitions, hardware and runtime
Lower is better | Green: decrease; red: increase | Each panel has its own zero-based scale
Measured means; percentage changes are descriptive and do not establish statistical significance.
Execution only; compilation and source I/O excluded.
